title: The boy at the front desk

cues.text: Inside, a lobby with sofas and a front desk. You walk up to the desk.
A boy in striped pyjamas peers over the top of the front desk. He snaps his fingers and is gone, and you turn around.
The boy stands in the hall beside you. He breaks apart into black specks and appears again by the front desk, next to the sofas. A book lies open on the desk.
On the desk lie the open book, a quill pen and a bell. You walk to the desk and pick up the pen.
